ClientHello.title: ClientHello
ClientHello.description: The first frame a client sends, naming the control-contract version it speaks. The server refuses a version it does not support before dispatching any method.

protocol_version.description: The [`CONTROL_CONTRACT_VERSION`](super::CONTROL_CONTRACT_VERSION) the client was built against.

ConfigDocument.title: ConfigDocument
ConfigDocument.description: The whole configuration as one redacted document, the result of `config.getAll`.

values.description: The effective configuration tree, every secret leaf redacted.

ConfigPath.title: ConfigPath
ConfigPath.description: The active configuration file's location, the result of `config.path`.

path.description: The filesystem path of the config file the binary reads and writes.

ConfigSchema.title: ConfigSchema
ConfigSchema.description: The whole writable configuration surface: the structural JSON Schema the form renders (types, enum choices, defaults, the dynamic maps' value shapes) paired with the per-key metadata overlay.

fields.description: The metadata overlay for each classifiable leaf key.

schema.description: The structural JSON Schema of the config type, carried opaquely.

ConfigFieldMeta.description: The metadata overlay for one configurable key, paired with the structural schema so a client can render and gate the settings form.

default_value.description: The key's fixed default, for a reset-to-default affordance. Absent for a machine-resolved key whose default is computed per host and stripped.

reload_class.description: Whether the key takes effect live or only on restart.

secret.description: Whether the value is a secret and reads back redacted.

shadowed.description: Whether a higher-precedence layer currently shadows this key, computed against the live cascade at the time of the call.

ReloadClass.description: Whether a key takes effect while the binary runs, or only on restart. Total over every field: v1 classifies nearly everything `requires_restart`, and a key is promoted to `hot` only once its live-reload substrate exists.

oneOf.description: The key reloads live, without a restart.
The key takes effect only after the binary restarts.

ConfigSetRequest.title: ConfigSetRequest
ConfigSetRequest.description: Parameters for `config.set`: the key and its new value.

value.description: The value to persist to the YAML file.

ConfigValidateRequest.title: ConfigValidateRequest
ConfigValidateRequest.description: Parameters for `config.validate`: a proposed write to check before committing it.

key.description: The dotted key the proposed value is for.

ConfigValidation.title: ConfigValidation
ConfigValidation.description: The verdict of `config.validate`: valid, or the reasons it is not.

valid.description: Whether the proposed configuration is acceptable.

violations.description: Every reason it is not, empty when it is.

ConfigViolation.description: One reason a proposed configuration is invalid.

key.description: The dotted key the violation is about.

message.description: A one-line description of what is wrong.

ConfigValue.title: ConfigValue
ConfigValue.description: One key's effective value, redacted when the key is a secret.

value.description: Its effective value; a secret renders as its redaction mask, never plaintext.

ConfigWriteOutcome.title: ConfigWriteOutcome
ConfigWriteOutcome.description: The outcome of a `config.set`: whether the persisted write took effect, and the layer shadowing it when it did not.

effect.description: Whether the write is live, awaiting restart, or shadowed.

shadowed_by.description: The higher-precedence source overriding the write, named only when the effect is [`WriteEffect::Shadowed`] — e.g. the environment variable that wins.

WriteEffect.description: What a write to a key achieved. The three honest outcomes of writing layer four of the cascade.

oneOf.description: The write is persisted but applies only after a restart.
A higher-precedence layer overrides the write, so it is persisted but never effective until that layer is cleared.

ControlEvent.title: ControlEvent
ControlEvent.description: A server-initiated event. Adjacently tagged so it serialises to the `{ method, params }` a JSON-RPC notification frame carries.

oneOf.description: One or more config keys changed on disk, with how the change took effect.
A new log line was emitted.
A prompt version was hot-reloaded from disk.

role.description: The prompt role within that stage.

stage.description: The pipeline stage whose prompt reloaded.

version_id.description: The id of the version now in force.

LogLevel.description: A log line's severity. The closed `tracing` level set.

LogLine.description: One captured log line, as the ring buffer holds it and the `logs.line` event streams it.

WriteEffect.description: What a write to a key achieved. The three honest outcomes of writing layer four of the cascade.

oneOf.description: The write is persisted but applies only after a restart.
A higher-precedence layer overrides the write, so it is persisted but never effective until that layer is cleared.

ControlNotification.title: ControlNotification
ControlNotification.description: A server-initiated notification — an event with no id and no reply. Its `method` and `params` are the wire projection of a [`ControlEvent`](super::event::ControlEvent).

params.description: The event's typed payload, absent for an event that carries none.

ControlRequest.title: ControlRequest
ControlRequest.description: A method call from client to server. `params` is absent for a method that takes none; the typed payload lives in this module's siblings.

id.description: The correlation id echoed on the matching response.

params.description: The method's typed parameters, absent when it takes none.

ControlResponse.title: ControlResponse
ControlResponse.description: A response to a [`ControlRequest`], pairing on the echoed [`RequestId`].

anyOf.description: The method succeeded, carrying its typed result.

id.description: The id of the request this answers.

ResponseError.description: A method's failure, in the JSON-RPC error shape.

data.description: Structured detail a client can branch on, absent when there is none.

LogLines.title: LogLines
LogLines.description: The trailing lines `logs.tail` returns, oldest first.

LogLevel.description: A log line's severity. The closed `tracing` level set.

LogLine.description: One captured log line, as the ring buffer holds it and the `logs.line` event streams it.

LogsTailRequest.title: LogsTailRequest
LogsTailRequest.description: Parameters for `logs.tail`: how many trailing lines to return.

lines.description: The number of most-recent lines to return, capped by the ring's size.

RestartOutcome.title: RestartOutcome
RestartOutcome.description: The answer to `server.restart`. The binary never re-execs itself silently: it either hands the restart to its supervisor or refuses.

oneOf.description: A supervisor owns the process; the binary is stopping and the supervisor will relaunch it.
No supervisor owns the process, so the binary refuses to restart itself; the caller must stop it and relaunch explicitly.

ServerHello.title: ServerHello
ServerHello.description: The server's answer to an accepted [`ClientHello`], confirming the contract version in force and identifying the binary.

protocol_version.description: The control-contract version the server speaks.

ServerStatus.title: ServerStatus
ServerStatus.description: A live introspection of the running server, the result of `server.status`.

bind_address.description: The bind address, when the transport listens on one.

project.description: The project being served, absent when none is resolved.

protocol_version.description: The control-contract version the server speaks.

queue_depth.description: The depth of the worker's job queue, when it can be read.

transport.description: The active transport the binary serves MCP over, e.g. `stdio` or `http`.

uptime_seconds.description: Seconds since the server began serving.

ProjectSummary.description: The project the binary is serving, when one is resolved.

WorkerStatus.description: The worker's liveness, as the status snapshot sees it.

oneOf.description: The worker task is alive and processing.

StopOutcome.title: StopOutcome
StopOutcome.description: The answer to `server.stop`: the binary is shutting down.

stopping.description: Whether the binary accepted the stop and is shutting down.

TokenList.title: TokenList
TokenList.description: Every issued token's metadata, the result of `token.list`.

tokens.description: The issued tokens, never their secret values.

TokenInfo.description: The non-secret metadata of one issued token.

expires_at.description: When the token expires, absent for a non-expiring token.

principal.description: The principal the token authenticates as.
